 UEFA Champions League Sporting CP vs LASK live online: score, stats, goals & updates | Champions League 2026/27
 Follow all the Champions League action as it happens as Sporting host LASK today, Wednesday October 21, at Estádio José Alvalade.
 AS USA Update: Oct 21st, 2026 14:30 EDT 0 Share facebook twitter whatsapp Make us preferred on Google Sporting have made an excellent start to the 2026-27 Champions League, following up a 3-1 home victory over Galatasaray with a 2-0 triumph away to Lens . The Lisbon side, who are unbeaten in the Portuguese league but sit six points behind leaders Porto, go into Wednesday’s game in good shape after having the weekend off.
 By contrast, LASK’s first-ever Champions League campaign hasn’t gone as they would have planned so far. The Austrians, who are third in their domestic league, narrowly lost to AEK Athens in their opening game before suffering a 6-3 thrashing at the hands of an understrength Liverpool team.
